entry: curl POST /mars/rpc/listAgentConfigs and listConfigSessions with X-Session-API-Key
expected: an agent holding the session key can list the team's DigitalOcean agents and sessions
actual: pr18604-live and openhands-do (agent openhands); openhands-do-xdati1 PAUSED; same call without a key: 401
note: Agent-path probe, after a person signed in through the UI.

expected: design goal: stock Agent Server clients (Python SDK, TypeScript client), which authenticate with a first auth message, can open the event socket
actual: no header: 401 Unauthorized at the upgrade; with X-Session-API-Key header: 409 (auth passed, session not connected)
note: Recorded against the agent goal; first-message auth is the clients' documented method.
